Definition: probably contraction for στεφανωτός (crowned; from G4737); Stephanas, a Christian:--Stephanas.
BiblicalUsage: Stephanas is the first household Paul baptized at Corinth, the firstfruits of Achaia, whose house addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints. Paul is glad of the coming of Stephanas, who supplied what was lacking.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the firstfruits household shows what a church is: a family that gives itself to serving the saints.
